- We planned to rotate a temporary API key and confirm SDK bootstrap (node/python).
- If you ran into firewall/VPN issues, we can do an alternate path (I list options below).

2) Asynchronous handoff: I share a short runbook and temporary key; you try the SDK and we do a quick debug thread
3) Reschedule a 30min troubleshooting slot tomorrow — please share windows

If option 2 is easiest, I can hand over a scoped key that expires in 24 hours and a pre-filled config file so you can try without joining a call. I attached the integration checklist and a sample quickstart YAML.

Apologies for the no-show friction — want to get you unblocked quickly.

Regards,
Logan Wright

Thanks Alex — understood on the VPN. Let's try the async path first to save calendar time. Actions below: 

1) I'm provisioning a temporary, scoped API key that only allows the sandbox model and expires in 24 hours. Key will be posted in a secure HubSpot note and also sent to your secure email after you confirm which option you prefer for receiving secrets.

2) Quick instructions (paste into terminal):
- npm i @redwood/inference-sdk
- export REDWOOD_API_KEY=redwood_temp_ABC123
- node samples/quickstart-node.js --model sandbox-alpha --prompt "hello"

3) If you see an error, please copy the exact error text and any curl/SDK output into a reply. Common blocker: 403 from a corporate proxy; if you get that, try a laptop tethered to phone data (short test) so we can confirm if it's a proxy issue.

4) Proposed backup slots for a troubleshooting call:
- Fri 13 Mar 2026 — 11:00–11:30am PST
- Fri 13 Mar 2026 — 2:00–2:30pm PST

Marissa will be on the call as well in case we need to reissue keys or examine logs. Ben — looping you for quick assist if the timeout/handshake looks odd on our side.

I'll send the key once you confirm the preferred secret delivery method (secure email vs DocuSign-style link).

Logan
